about: Melissa N. Smart is a highly regarded family law attorney, recognized for her dedication to the field and her comprehensive understanding of complex legal matters. Admitted to the bar in both Texas and California, she has cultivated a reputation for excellence in family law. After spending eight years practicing in San Francisco, she relocated to Texas in 2019, where she co-founded Smart & Malone Family Law Group, PLLC, in Katy, Texas. She extends her practice to greater Katy and Houston, including Harris County, Fort Bend County, Montgomery County, Galveston County, Austin County, Tarrant County, Waller County, Brazoria County and more.

Ms. Smart's practice is focused on family law, encompassing areas such as divorce, child custody, property division and family violence. Her approach is strategic and client-centered, ensuring each case is handled with the utmost care and attention. She is adept at navigating high net worth and complex property division cases, as well as contested child custody issues. Her ability to collaborate with other professionals and her understanding of unique family dynamics highlight her commitment to delivering exceptional legal services.

Throughout her career, Ms. Smart has been actively involved in her professional community. She served as chair and co-chair of the Family Law Section of the San Mateo County Bar Association. Her accolades reflect her dedication to the legal profession and her peers' recognition of her achievements. She has also received a perfect “10.0” rating on Avvo.

In 2024, Ms. Smart achieved board certification in family law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization, further underscoring her proficiency in the field. She is also a member of the Texas Bar College Society of Legal Scholars and holds a professional mediator certification. Originally from Washington state, she graduated first in her class from Golden Gate University School of Law in San Francisco, demonstrating her academic excellence and commitment to the legal field.
